title: DFA has no update on Harry Roque’s asylum bid
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has no update on former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque’s bid for political asylum in Austria, DFA Secretary Theresa Lazaro said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) has no update on former presidential spokesperson Harry Roque’s bid for political asylum in Austria, DFA Secretary Theresa Lazaro said Friday. This contradicts the statement of Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla who previously claimed Roque’s asylum request was denied. “According to our embassy in Vienna, there is no information at all if the asylum has been denied,” Lazaro told the Senate finance subcommittee.
